Dates: Hebcal. Source: the existing 500-entry blog index plus four non-Talmud entries supplied in the comparison index. Verse matching checks titles and source references, not full post text. Narrative keywords and curated direct connections extend coverage. Broader thematic, haftarah, and seasonal suggestions are optional. A chapter range can span several portions; each receives a separate index row. This can create more than one repost opportunity for the same article.

Combined portions share a reading date. Identical post events on the same date are merged in the filtered export. Festival weeks pause the regular cycle; Vezot Haberakhah follows Simchat Torah. Daf Yomi dates include subsequent occurrences within the cached calendar. Calendar exports contain Sunday repost events with multipart links, plus one event for every parasha reading with its chapter and verse range. Weekly readings fall on Saturday; Vezot Haberakhah stays on its actual Simchat Torah date. They do not publish anything.
